question: Should #54397 close as implemented by the merged session-thread UI, or stay open as the umbrella for remaining CLI/TUI/topic metadata and import/export work?
rationale: Current main implements the main web UI management gap, but the original request still contains broader lifecycle and topic-model features that need product scoping before automation should act.

options.title: Close UI Umbrella
options.body: Treat #98510 plus the merged /name command as satisfying the topic-management UI request, and rely on narrower issues such as #90916, #63118, and #87662 for the remaining slices.

options.title: Keep For Scoping
options.body: Keep #54397 open until maintainers split or confirm ownership for the remaining CLI lifecycle, TUI actions, topic metadata, and import/export semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep For Scoping
recommendation.body: Keep #54397 open until maintainers split or confirm ownership for the remaining CLI lifecycle, TUI actions, topic metadata, and import/export semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the merged session-thread implementation that determines whether the umbrella is now complete enough to close.
